title: Tattoo
wikitext:
A '''tattoo''' is a type of [[currency item]]. They are applied to specific types of passive skills on the [[passive skill tree]] to transform the passive into a different one. ==Mechanics== * Tattoos can be replaced by applying another tattoo or removed using an {{il|Orb of Scouring}} on the passive. * You must have the passive skill allocated in order to apply a tattoo to it. Unallocating the passive does not remove the tattoo. * Each character can have up to 50 tattoos applied. * 3 tattoos from the same tribe can be vendored to obtain a single random tattoo of the same tribe. Special tattoo types that can only be obtained in [[permanent league]]s have additional restrictions or conditions: * Makanga tattoos only grant effects when you have either one or fewer adjacent passive allocated or 7+ or 8+ connected passives (including Keystones) allocated, depending on the tattoo type. * Loyalty tattoos are limited to 1. * Attribute notable honoured tattoos are limited to 1. ===Interactions=== * {{il|Unnatural Instinct}} will grant the effects of tattoos on small unallocated passives. * {{il|Might of the Meek}} and {{il|Warrior's Tale}} increase the effects of tattoo stats. * {{il|Lethal Pride}}, {{il|Brutal Restraint}}, {{il|Militant Faith}} (non-transformed passives only), and [[Chieftain]]'s {{psl|Ngamahu, Flame's Advance}} grant their respective stats in addition to stats from the tattoo. ** Transformed passives ({{il|Glorious Vanity}}, {{il|Elegant Hubris}}, {{il|Militant Faith}} (transformed notables), attribute conversion jewels, etc.) prevent/disable tattoos from applying. * Notable Passives which are [[Annoint|anointed]] will reflect the tattoo's stats and not the original notable. * Items that allow passives to be allocated without being connected to your tree, such as {{il|Impossible Escape}}, and {{il|page=Thread of Hope}} can allow efficient placement of tattoos, especially those with "Maximum 1 adjacent Passive Skills Allocated". ==Acquisition== Tattoos can be received from [[Kingsmarch]] shipments sent to Karui ports (Ngakanu, Te Onui, Mota Aro). Each port will give tattoos that can be applied to a specific attribute: * Ngakanu: [[Strength]] * Te Onui: [[Dexterity]] * Moti Aro: [[Intelligence]] They can also sometimes be obtained from Lost Karui Goods chests with the {{psl|Lost in Transit}} Atlas passive skill. In [[The Karui Fortress]] in [[Act 6]], there is a bridge that leads to a small island containing a pack of Tukohama tribe monsters that drop a random tattoo when killed (once per character). ==Table of tattoos== {{See also|List of tattoos}} The following tattoos can be obtained by sending shipments to [[Karui]] ports from [[Kingsmarch]]. Relative weights within each tribe (for the vendor recipe) are included for referencehttps://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1mg8ozd/results_from_vendoring_60000_tattoos/; the chance for a specific tribe is roughly similar to each otherhttps://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1p6dw4m/loot_from_11_hours_of_farming_tattoos_112_maps/. Most tribes have a distribution of 3:3:3:1:1, except for Kitava tribe which may have a distribution of 4:2:2:2:1. Certain tattoos could only be obtained as a reward for defeating certain tribes or by winning the Trial. During [[Necropolis league]], certain [[Allflame ember (Necropolis league)|Allflame embers]] could be used to replace monster packs with a Karui monster packs that dropped tattoos. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.28.0j| * Temporarily re-introduced drop-disabled tattoos exclusively for the [[Return of the Ancestors]] event. * Added Silver Coin and all Trial of the Ancestors exclusive Tattoos to the Currency Exchange. * Silver Coins and Forbidden Tattoos will be deleted at the end of the Return of the Ancestors event. * For the Return of the Ancestors event Lost Karui Shipments and Shipping to Karui Ports will reward [[Runegraft]]s instead of Tattoos. }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Tattoos can be obtained once again in the [[Settlers league]] from shipping resources from [[Kingsmarch]] to Karui ports. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.24.0| * Tattoos can be obtained once again in the [[Necropolis league]] from [[Allflame ember (Necropolis league)|Allflame embers]] of Karui tribes. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.22.1| * Added 6 new [[Tattoo]]s that can be obtained in the Trial of the Ancestors.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3421370 * Added a vendor recipe that can be used to trade three Tattoos from a tribe for a random single Tattoo of that same tribe. * The number of skills used by Minions summoned through Loyalty Tattoos modifiers has been reduced. These Minions are primarily used for their buffing abilities and their other skills had a lot of visual impact without dealing much damage. * Updated the icon art for many Tattoo-replaced Passive Skills to be more appropriate. * [[Loyalty Tattoo]]s that take effect while a [[Unique]] Enemy is in your Presence now have their range displayed in the Character Panel. }} {{Version history table row|3.22.0| * Introduced to the game in [[Ancestor league]]. }} {{Version history table end}} ==See also== * [[Runegraft]] ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Navbox Settlers}} [[Category:Tattoos| ]] [[Category:Trial of the Ancestors]]
